handback.summary: No code change this round: the earlier build passes every planned test and both updated older tests.

criteria.796.1: `dokima/settings.py` exports `CO_AUTHOR`; `agent.yml` and `wiki.yml` add the trailer only when it is set.
criteria.796.2: `agent.yml` copies the owner docs file the settings name and its linked topic files; a missing one only warns.
criteria.796.3: `dokima/prompt.py` `build()` puts the owner docs file in place of every AGENTS.md in the prompt.
criteria.796.4: `dokima/prompt.py` `build()` writes the protected paths into the worker's never-edit line.
criteria.796.5: `dokima/prompt.py` `runner_line()` draws the planner's runner line from the test settings.
criteria.796.6: `dokima/prompt.py` `caps_table()` fills each cap row from the caps setting, defaults otherwise.
criteria.796.7: `agent.yml` reads main's house rules file and appends it after the shipped prompt.
criteria.796.8: `dokima/prompt.py` `for_role()` keeps shared rules and only the role's own section.
criteria.796.9: `dokima/defaults.yaml` ships `co_author` empty, so no trailer without a setting.
criteria.796.10: `.dokima/settings.yaml` holds the owner's co-author line for this repo.
